comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber for repeatable non-bottoming stops; record releases a glove box, removes an old filter, and inserts a replacement.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate emphasizes hex-key alignment, torque-limited unlocking/relocking, collar adjustment, and iterative dynamic diagnosis. Record emphasizes simultaneous wall squeezing, articulated-box release, tab pulling, and large flat-part slot insertion. Bimanual force application and insertion are generic shared primitives only.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate scores impact behavior, stroke, hard-stop avoidance, overload/rebound avoidance, and setting retention over two cycles. Record scores safe passage through paired stops, complete old-filter extraction, new-filter pose tolerances, release, and settling. Candidate lacks numeric overload, rebound, and collar-drift thresholds, but the record tests unrelated replacement outcomes.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests adjustable damping calibration and lock integrity; the record tests simultaneous compliant release followed by component replacement.
